{{Quote|Where are ''you'' going?''"<br />"''Blackfel. The stormtrooper commandos are stationed there.''"<br />"''Blackfel? That whole moon is a training facility for the Empire!|[[Connor Freeman]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" />}}
'''Blackfel''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 3" /> located in the [[Blackfel system/Legends|Blackfel system]], within the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The entire moon was a [[Imperial base (Blackfel)|training facility]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" />
